title: Mango trees
subtitle: Jump at a branch to climb up for mangoes.

sections.name: Grove
sections.note: The bund road into the mango grove: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstTree
sections.note: The first mango tree, a haystack before it: hop onto the stack, jump at the branch, run along it for the mangoes.

sections.name: Canal
sections.note: A 1.2 m canal: jump it.

sections.name: Branch
sections.note: A branch with no step: a double jump gets her up (or a well-timed jump).

sections.name: Dung
sections.note: Cow dung on the road.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: TreeFeather
sections.note: A tree with a haystack step and a feather above its branch: up, along, a double jump at the end.

sections.name: Plank
sections.note: The plank over a 1.8 m canal.

sections.name: SacksTree
sections.note: Sacks of paddy waiting for the cart as the step: onto them, and up onto the branch.

sections.name: CanalDung
sections.note: A canal, then dung.

sections.name: Haystacks
sections.note: Two small haystacks: hop, hop.

sections.name: TreeCanal
sections.note: A tree, then a canal after its branch.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: Orchard
sections.note: Three trees in a row, 2 m between their branches: branch to branch, a feather above the middle one.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: Dung; the rooster knocks the water pots off their stand by the well into the road; a canal after.

sections.name: WideTree
sections.note: The wide canal (double jump, a feather at its top), then a tree with a haystack step.

sections.name: ChilliRun
sections.note: A chilli and a run of mangoes.

sections.name: DucksCanal
sections.note: Ducks waddling up from the canal: jump them, then the canal.

sections.name: TreesAndStacks
sections.note: A tree, a haystack, then sacks as the step up to another tree.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: PlankDung
sections.note: The plank, then dung.

sections.name: LastTrees
sections.note: The last two trees (a haystack before the first), a canal between them.

sections.name: DungStack
sections.note: Dung, then a haystack.

sections.name: LastWide
sections.note: The last wide canal.

sections.name: OpenGrove
sections.note: The road opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 295 m.
